equipment.machine.create.description: Add a machine to the shop floor. Kind is required (fdm, sla, cnc, laser, robot); name, location and serial number can follow later.

en: I want to register a machine (equipment in sf-equipment)
fr: s’il te plaît, enregistre a machine

equipment.machine.set-state.description: Mark a machine as running, idle, in maintenance, in error or offline. Needs a machine in context. Error reports a breakdown: the running slot is released, the order on it is blocked and the workspace is notified — pass what happened as description.

description.description: What happened, when the state is error

en: I want to set machine state (equipment in sf-equipment)
de: ich möchte stelle ein machine state
fr: s’il te plaît, configure machine state
